constraints.name: chk_rake_amount_is_two_decimal_places
constraints.definition: CHECK (rake_amount IS NULL OR rake_amount = round(rake_amount, 2))

constraints.name: ck_whole_cents
constraints.definition: CHECK (created_at < '2026-09-07 22:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone OR rake_amount = round(rake_amount, 2) AND weighted_rake_credit = round(weighted_rake_credit, 2)) NOT VALID

constraints.name: rake_attributions_agent_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (agent_id) REFERENCES agents(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: rake_attributions_player_id_fkey
